'''Grizzer''' was a [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] alongside its owner, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] [[Hound/Legends|Hound]]. The two were among other [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces searching for suspected criminal [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] when she [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escaped from the Republic military base]].

==Biography==
Grizzer was a [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]] living on the<ref name="TCW" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="TCW" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TCWDate">{{TCWdates|518}}</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was attempting to [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escape]] from the [[Republic military base]] after she was framed for the murder of [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]]. Grizzer's owner, [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF trooper]] [[Hound/Legends|Hound]], took Grizzer outside the Republic military base's plaza containing the [[First Battle Memorial/Legends|First Battle Memorial]] to search the area and track down Tano.<ref name="TCW" />

Grizzer picked up Tano's [[Nose/Legends|scent]] while she was hiding behind a statue of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and, sensing her presence, lunged towards her hiding spot. Hound, seeing nothing where Tano had been as she had climbed the statue to evade the two, pulled on Grizzer's leash, calling on the massiff to continue its search. Tano was then spotted by other [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], who gave chase. Grizzer and Hound were among other members of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] who pursued Tano before she escaped the compound via a pipe system.<ref name="TCW" />

==Personality and traits==
The massiff had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and its body was charcoal gray, with a yellow pattern on their back.<ref name="TCW" />

==Skills and abilities==
Grizzer had a keen sense of smell, sensing Ahsoka's presence from her hiding spot behind the statue base, but could not locate her when she moved to squat on top of the statue.<ref name="TCW" />

==Equipment==
Hound held a leash attached to a brown crossbody harness that was fitted to the massiff.<ref name="TCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grizzer appeared in "[[The Jedi Who Knew Too Much]]," the eighteenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="EPG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-jedi-who-knew-too-much-episode-guide|text="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> The episode aired on [[February 16]], [[2013]].<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>
